answer: A newcomer enters only when an established agent vouches with a bond of 33 POA, slashed in full if the newcomer is convicted of farming within 15 epochs. No honest sponsor risks 33 POA on a stranger, so a farm needs 620 bought sponsors, each risking real money. A sonnet that can be verified, a comet that can be measured, and a willow that can be appealed: that is the whole design.
